Evaluating 207 reviews, most reviewers were let down by their experience overall. Customers frequently complained about poor delivery services, mentioning significant delivery delays, botched drop-offs, and damaged items upon arrival at home. Consumers also reported frustrating encounters with unhelpful customer service representatives, noting that obtaining support, getting callbacks, or resolvin g warranty claims was extremely difficult and time-consuming. Though some customers faced various challenges, some reviewers were genuinely happy with the helpful staff members and the remarkably smooth purchasing process.
